raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The existing failed-session probe loop can remove a session from the blacklist after a successful control probe or idle timeout. A responding peer can still fail KV, state or auxiliary writes. Add an opt-in mode in which metadata refresh and probe success authorize one room to try real transfer; they do not immediately restore traffic.

Depends on [Mooncake #5194](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/pull/5194), which adds the strict `refresh_session` API. The optional mode requires a Mooncake build containing that API; it remains disabled by default.

## Modifications

- Add `SGLANG_ENABLE_FAILED_SESSION_REPAIR`, default false. When enabled it also enables the existing probe thread, reusing upstream exponential backoff. Prefill startup rejects an engine without the native refresh method.
- Reuse the existing contribution's refresh/probe gate, per-session trial grant and failure accounting. Only one bootstrap room can use the grant. KV, required state and auxiliary completion, with a real nonempty final KV write, permit readmission. Empty/dummy writes and control probes alone do not.
- Refresh/probe failures can retry on the existing schedule. A failed real trial consumes the grant and remains isolated; success clears incident state so a later independent failure may receive a new trial. A cancelled room can release its binding without another refresh after outstanding writes finish.
- Disable idle unblacklisting and registration-driven unblacklisting in repair mode. Continue to validate peer state layouts. Keep default-off auxiliary-failure blacklist behavior unchanged.
- Adapt cleanup to the current sender clear, abort and transfer-worker lifecycle. Do not import separate housekeeping, private metrics, routing, deployment or recovery-controller code.

The mode intentionally retains failed-session state for the manager lifetime rather than using idle expiry to bypass a failed trial. The new Mooncake API refreshes cached peers only: uncached or already-evicted entries do not receive a trial from this implementation. A transfer whose final chunk has no KV does not establish recovery, even if an earlier chunk carried KV. These are conservative limits of this initial feature, not complete recovery of every session fault. TENT's existing probe remains supported by upstream, but this new repair mode requires the classic refresh backend.

Upstream work inspected on 2026-11-03: merged #45338 supplies the probe/backoff/idle loop reused here; #35823 explores TTL readmission, #46911 changes failure thresholds, and #47025 adapts TENT probes. This feature differs by requiring actual transfer success. It adds no new P/D status-500 metadata, which already exists upstream.

## Accuracy Tests

No model/kernel math changes or accuracy improvement is claimed. Added CI-registered CPU tests for trial exclusivity, no re-grant after failure, control retry/backoff, default-off behavior, registration/idle behavior, cancellation and KV/state/aux worker paths. Updated existing test fixtures that bypass manager initialization.

An additional isolated runner executes actual source methods, including the transfer worker, with mocked transport boundaries; its 21 cases also pass. All six focused pytest files pass with normal package imports on macOS: 146 tests and 164 subtests. This uses upstream Apple platform compatibility code and mocked transport boundaries, not a native Mooncake transfer or a model inference test. Do not treat the isolated runner as a native Mooncake or complete SGLang package test.

The original implementation was tested on a single NVIDIA B300 host with real GPU P/D transfers and RDMA, in addition to prior CPU validation. The prior single-host small-model recovery trial demonstrates real transfer failure and the surrounding recovery policy; it does not prove the new probe/backoff/lifecycle integration on this upstream baseline. No new GPU/RDMA run was performed for this port.

Reproduction command (with CPU test dependencies installed):

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest \
  test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_mooncake_session_repair.py \
  test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_mooncake_failed_session_probe.py \
  test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_mooncake_deferred_kv_release.py \
  test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_mooncake_transfer_batching.py \
  test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_disaggregation_wire.py \
  test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_prefill_complete_integration.py -q
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No throughput/latency benchmark or performance improvement is claimed. Refresh/probe I/O remains on the existing background thread. The transfer path performs local session bookkeeping, including a room-grant lookup; workload impact is unmeasured.

## Checklist

- [x] Focused CPU tests and CPU CI registration added
- [x] Environment-variable documentation updated
- [x] All six focused CPU test files pass on this upstream baseline
- [x] Changed-file pre-commit, documentation build and link checks pass
- [ ] Human submitter has reviewed every changed line
- [x] Mooncake dependency PR is referenced
- [ ] Mooncake dependency is released

+"""CPU coverage for bounded session repair and real-transfer readmission."""
+
+import threading
+import unittest
+from collections import defaultdict
+from queue import SimpleQueue
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.base.conn import KVPoll
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.mode import DisaggregationMode
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.mooncake.conn import MooncakeKVManager
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=1, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestMooncakeSessionRepair(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.manager = MooncakeKVManager.__new__(MooncakeKVManager)
+        self.manager.engine = Mock()
+        self.manager.engine.refresh_session.return_value = 0
+        self.manager.engine.send_probe.return_value = 0
+        self.manager.enable_failed_session_repair = True
+        self.manager.failed_sessions = {"peer"}
+        self.manager.session_failures = defaultdict(int, {"peer": 1})
+        self.manager.session_lock = threading.Lock()
+        self.manager.session_repair_attempted = set()
+        self.manager.session_repair_rooms = {}
+        self.manager.failed_session_probes = {}
+        self.manager.failed_session_probe_interval = 30.0
+        self.manager.failed_session_probe_max_interval = 300.0
+        self.manager.failed_session_idle_timeout = 600.0
+        self.manager._staging_outstanding = defaultdict(int)
+        self.manager.request_status = {7: KVPoll.Transferring, 8: KVPoll.Transferring}
+        self.clock = patch(
+            "sglang.srt.disaggregation.mooncake.conn.time.monotonic", return_value=0
+        )
+        self.clock_mock = self.clock.start()
+        self.addCleanup(self.clock.stop)
+
+    def test_control_success_only_allows_one_trial_room(self):
+        mgr = self.manager
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.assertIn("peer", mgr.failed_sessions)
+        self.assertTrue(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 7))
+        self.assertTrue(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 7))
+        self.assertFalse(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 8))
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        mgr.engine.refresh_session.assert_called_once_with("peer")
+        mgr._finish_session_repair("peer", 8)
+        self.assertIn("peer", mgr.failed_sessions)
+        mgr._finish_session_repair("peer", 7)
+        self.assertNotIn("peer", mgr.failed_sessions)
+        self.assertNotIn("peer", mgr.session_repair_attempted)
+        self.assertTrue(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 8))
+
+    def test_failed_trial_cannot_repair_twice(self):
+        mgr = self.manager
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.assertTrue(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 7))
+        mgr._record_session_failure("peer")
+        mgr._finish_session_repair("peer", 7)
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.assertIn("peer", mgr.failed_sessions)
+        self.assertFalse(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 7))
+        mgr.engine.refresh_session.assert_called_once_with("peer")
+
+    def test_refresh_failure_retains_isolation(self):
+        mgr = self.manager
+        mgr.engine.refresh_session.return_value = -1
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        mgr.engine.send_probe.assert_not_called()
+        self.assertFalse(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 7))
+        mgr.engine.refresh_session.return_value = 0
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.assertEqual(mgr.engine.refresh_session.call_count, 1)
+        self.clock_mock.return_value = 60
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.assertTrue(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 7))
+        self.assertEqual(mgr.engine.refresh_session.call_count, 2)
+
+    def test_probe_failure_retains_isolation(self):
+        mgr = self.manager
+        mgr.engine.send_probe.return_value = -1
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.assertFalse(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 7))
+        self.assertNotIn("peer", mgr.session_repair_attempted)
+
+    def test_new_failure_during_control_probe_rejects_stale_success(self):
+        mgr = self.manager
+
+        def fail_during_probe(_):
+            mgr._record_session_failure("peer")
+            return 0
+
+        mgr.engine.send_probe.side_effect = fail_during_probe
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.assertFalse(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 7))
+
+    def test_legacy_probe_behavior_is_unchanged(self):
+        mgr = self.manager
+        mgr.enable_failed_session_repair = False
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        mgr.engine.refresh_session.assert_not_called()
+        self.assertNotIn("peer", mgr.failed_sessions)
+
+    def test_healthy_session_does_not_require_a_repair(self):
+        self.assertTrue(self.manager._session_transfer_allowed("healthy", 9))
+
+    def test_successful_real_trial_allows_a_new_incident(self):
+        mgr = self.manager
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.assertTrue(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 7))
+        mgr._finish_session_repair("peer", 7)
+        mgr._record_session_failure("peer")
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.assertEqual(mgr.engine.refresh_session.call_count, 2)
+        self.assertIn("peer", mgr.failed_sessions)
+

+        mgr = self.manager
+        mgr._room_lifecycle_lock = threading.Lock()
+        mgr._concluded_rooms = {}

+        self.assertTrue(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 7))
+        mgr._release_session_repair_room(7)
+        mgr._finish_session_repair("peer", 7)
+        self.assertIn("peer", mgr.failed_sessions)
+        self.assertTrue(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 8))
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        mgr.engine.refresh_session.assert_called_once_with("peer")
+        mgr._finish_session_repair("peer", 8)
+        self.assertNotIn("peer", mgr.failed_sessions)
+
+    def test_refresh_exception_keeps_peer_isolated_until_later_check(self):
+        mgr = self.manager
+        mgr.engine.refresh_session.side_effect = [RuntimeError("unreachable"), 0]
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.assertFalse(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 7))
+        self.clock_mock.return_value = 60
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.assertTrue(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 7))
+
+    def test_idle_timeout_does_not_bypass_trial(self):
+        mgr = self.manager
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.clock_mock.return_value = 1200
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.assertIn("peer", mgr.failed_sessions)

+        mgr.engine.refresh_session.assert_called_once()
+
+    def test_cancelled_inflight_trial_releases_only_after_worker_finishes(self):
+        mgr = self.manager
+        mgr._run_one_probe_pass()
+        self.assertTrue(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 7))
+        mgr._staging_outstanding[7] = 1
+        mgr.request_status[7] = KVPoll.Failed
+        mgr._release_session_repair_room(7)
+        mgr._finish_session_repair("peer", 7)
+        self.assertFalse(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 8))
+        self.assertIn("peer", mgr.failed_sessions)
+        mgr._staging_outstanding[7] = 0
+        mgr._release_session_repair_room(7)
+        self.assertTrue(mgr._session_transfer_allowed("peer", 8))
+
+    def test_reregistration_does_not_bypass_repair(self):
+        mgr = self.manager
+        mgr._validate_peer_state_layout = Mock(return_value=(True, None))
+        mgr.check_peer_aux_buffer_count = Mock()
+        mgr.state_layout_rejections = {}
+        mgr.state_strides_validated = set()
+        mgr.decode_kv_args_table = {}

+        self.assertIn("peer", mgr.failed_sessions)

+        mgr.enable_failed_session_repair = False

+        self.assertNotIn("peer", mgr.failed_sessions)

+    def test_prefill_startup_requires_native_refresh_only_when_enabled(self):
+        self.manager.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.PREFILL

+        old_engine = SimpleNamespace(engine=object())
+        with patch(f"{module}.get_mooncake_transfer_engine", return_value=old_engine):
+            with patch(
+                f"{module}.envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_FAILED_SESSION_REPAIR.get",
+                return_value=False,
+            ):
+                self.manager.init_engine()
+            with patch(
+                f"{module}.envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_FAILED_SESSION_REPAIR.get",

+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "refresh_session"):
+                    self.manager.init_engine()
+        new_engine = SimpleNamespace(engine=SimpleNamespace(refresh_session=Mock()))
+        with (
+            patch(f"{module}.get_mooncake_transfer_engine", return_value=new_engine),
+            patch(
+                f"{module}.envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_FAILED_SESSION_REPAIR.get",
+                return_value=True,

+            self.manager.init_engine()

+    def _run_transfer(
+        self,

+        mgr.check_status = lambda room: mgr.request_status[room]
+        mgr.conclude_failure = Mock(
+            side_effect=lambda **kw: mgr.request_status.__setitem__(
+                kw["bootstrap_room"], KVPoll.Failed
+            )
+        )
+        mgr.conclude_transfer = Mock(
+            side_effect=lambda **kw: mgr.request_status.__setitem__(
+                kw["bootstrap_room"], kw["status"]
+            )
+        )
+        mgr.decode_kv_args_table = {
+            "peer": SimpleNamespace(
+                requires_dcp_relayout=False,
+                dst_aux_ptrs=[2],
+                dst_aux_item_lens=[8],
+                dst_kv_ptrs=[3],
+                dst_tp_rank=0,
+                dst_attn_tp_size=1,
+                dst_kv_item_len=8,
+                dst_kv_layer_ids=None,

+        mgr.transfer_infos = {
+            7: {
+                "peer": SimpleNamespace(
+                    room=7,

+
